summary: Ignazio Abate, born in 1986, is an Italian football coach and former right full-back. He is head coach of Serie A club Torino. As a player he was known for his speed and stamina. He came through AC Milan's youth system and made his debut for the club in 2003. After five years on loan at other Italian clubs, he returned to Milan in 2009. He became the regular right back and helped Milan win the 2010–11 Serie A title. He played ten straight seasons for Milan, making 306 appearances, before leaving in 2019 and retiring in 2020. For Italy he made his debut in 2011, reached the Euro 2012 final, won bronze at the 2013 Confederations Cup and played at the 2014 World Cup. He began coaching Milan's youth teams in 2021.
